title.value: Read books, PDFs, and blogs with agent mode

introduction.value: A user has been using ChatGPT Agent mode to read books, PDFs, and blogs and to scan content generally, and says it does a great job.

method.value: The poster says they spent two weeks using ChatGPT’s agent mode to go through books, PDFs, blogs, and websites for research. They would point it at documents or links, have it read through roughly 10 pages or more, summarize takeaways, and pull out insights they could reuse for work such as product feature ideation, while they kept the final reading and idea use themselves.

outcome.value: They report it did a great job, especially for research, and say it gave excellent insights on cancer data and causes and worked well for extracting takeaways from a book for product feature validation. The thread gives no hard metrics or detailed failures.

notes.value: The clearest catch is that the source is anecdotal: after about two weeks of use, the poster still says it helps surface insights rather than replacing reading entirely.

source_text.body:
Read books, PDFs, and blogs with agent mode
A user has been using ChatGPT Agent mode to read books, PDFs, and blogs and to scan content generally, and says it does a great job.
Done with
GA
ChatGPT Agent
What they did
The poster says they spent two weeks using ChatGPT’s agent mode to go through books, PDFs, blogs, and websites for research. They would point it at documents or links, have it read through roughly 10 pages or more, summarize takeaways, and pull out insights they could reuse for work such as product feature ideation, while they kept the final reading and idea use themselves.
How it went
They report it did a great job, especially for research, and say it gave excellent insights on cancer data and causes and worked well for extracting takeaways from a book for product feature validation. The thread gives no hard metrics or detailed failures.
Worth knowing
The clearest catch is that the source is anecdotal: after about two weeks of use, the poster still says it helps surface insights rather than replacing reading entirely.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Read [book, PDF link or blog URLs] and give me [a chapter-by-chapter summary, key arguments, or a list of notable quotes]. Focus on [topic or question I care about] and note where the source covers it. Finish with a one-page summary and a list of [number] follow-up questions or sources worth reading.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPT/comments/1q4njrl/chatgpt_agent_mode_is_awesome_i_am_love_it
